messages:
Maya (CS): FYI ApolloBio (ACC-APO-21) spotted a strange charge on May invoice INV-2026-05-2104. Looks like a retrospective usage batch rerun added ~850k tokens counted twice on 2026-05-03. Can billing take a look?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-05-2104 generated 2026-05-05 08:12 UTC. Lines include USAGE-TOKENS 1,200,450 tokens $1,080.36; Reserved-M 2 GPUs $3,600.00; Total due $4,680.36.

Ravi (Billing): Pulling logs. I see a background job reprocessed a delayed batch on 2026-05-03 and duplicate entries were ingested into the usage ledger. Tag: USG-dup-2026-05-03.

Jordan (Finance): If duplicate ingestion, we should issue a reversing credit for the duplicated tokens + any associated taxes. Do we have a quick qty for duplicates?

Ravi (Billing): Duplicate quantity = 850,200 tokens. Rate = $0.001 per 1k tokens => raw charge $850.20. Taxes (NY customer): 8.875% => tax on duplicated portion = $75.47. Total corrective credit = 925.67. Suggest memo CR-2026-05-321.

Maya (CS): Customer asked for same-day reversal if possible. Also wants a short note they can share with procurement.

Jordan (Finance): Approve credit up to $1,000. This is operational error. Ravi, create credit memo and add customer note: "Duplicate usage ingestion due to background batch job; credit applied."

Ravi (Billing): Creating credit memo now. Entry: 
```
CreditMemo: CR-2026-05-321
Customer: ACC-APO-21 (ApolloBio)
Amount: -925.67 USD
AppliedTo: INV-2026-05-2104
Reason: Duplicate usage ingestion (USG-dup-2026-05-03)
CreatedBy: Ravi (Billing)
```
Applied 2026-05-05 14:30 UTC.

ops-bot: Background job USG-processor rerun on 2026-05-03 flagged; engineers notified (ENG-usage-98).

billing-bot: CreditMemo CR-2026-05-321 created and applied to INV-2026-05-2104. New balance: $3,754.69.

Maya (CS): Thanks all 97 I'll tell ApolloBio and attach CR-2026-05-321 + ENG-usage-98. They appreciated the quick turnaround. Closing.
